events.generator: repository GenesisPhysicsEventPlugin; CPU, NumPy warp backend
events.input: same scene-linear float32 radiance frames used by the physical interpolation plugin
events.sensor_calibration: uncalibrated; reused Stage-5 pilot values only

flow.depth_contract: Genesis renderer depth supplied as z-depth; independently checked by analytic translation relation
flow.expected_relation: u=-fx*camera_dx/z; v=0 for unchanged orientation and static world
flow.units: pixel displacement over t0 to t30ms

limitations: camera translation only; no independently moving objects or visibility change trajectory
EventGenesis pilot only; V2E has not yet consumed these exact frames
physics flow is checked against an analytic camera-only pinhole relation, but scene conversion validity is not comprehensively certified
raw renderer segmentation IDs retained and not mapped to physical link IDs; no moving-object labels used
sensor radiometric calibration and actual camera characterization remain unverified
